convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; contract pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story budget); targets = NORMALIZED prototype driven per states.json journeys under the freeze protocol (FREEZE_CSS + FREEZE_JS_SCROLLING emulation from fidelity/src/drive.js), Chromium (playwright 1.58 / Chromium headless shell 151.0.7922.34), viewports 1280x1400 (default) / 480x1000 (narrow-inline-play) per states.json, deviceScaleFactor 2, --disable-lcd-text --font-render-hinting=none (GC-009/GC-011 capture fact), fonts.ready + double-rAF quiescence. VIDEO-STATE NORMALIZATION (per the states.json PIXEL NOTE, 'the capture normalizes the player to its poster'): for video-modal-open and narrow-inline-play the target render pauses+hides the <video> node (poster shows via the player's --iv-poster background / the thumb img), restores the modal cap to visible (iv-fadeout removed under frozen transitions), and suppresses the thumb foot-fade on the iv-playing figure (a paused <video poster> shows the bare poster) — matching the land-story contract 'video mounted paused on its poster, cap visible'. RASTER POLICY: photo/poster surfaces and the two overlay-state page-under-scrim backdrops are baked browser-rendered assets (not tokenizable), clipped OUTWARD to integer CSS px and placed 1:1 on the device grid; every color surface over them (scrims, fades, chips, type, badges) is a token-bound pen layer. Geometry probes: 52/52 (tile border/wash, dot colors+active accent, paddle surface, photo presence, modal shell border/player 16:9/poster/surface) asserted on the export pixels.
convergence.iterationNotes: Five honest author->export->compare iterations, no plateau: (1) 9.5% class — three systematic authoring errors diagnosed: the 0.5-CSS-px root-vs-rounded-clip offset applied to every node; media assets captured at Playwright's floored fractional clip (402 rows) then stretched by pen into 402.75 device rows (photo smear); raw \n retained in collapsed-whitespace text (modal title rendered 3 lines). (2) offset+snap+whitespace fixes -> 4.5% class. (3) text-calibration table rebuilt after discovering the original fragment metrics were measured BEFORE Heebo loaded (fallback-font junk; real Heebo hhea inline box = 1.5em so fragment tops sit ABOVE the line box for line-heights < 1.5) -> 6 states passing. (4) asset clips snapped OUTWARD to integer CSS px (Playwright floors fractional clip sizes) -> 10/11 passing. (5) responsive-rows: rows 2/3 sit at fractional device offsets (356.67-tall cards) where a row-1 asset cannot serve — asset dedupe keyed by sub-device-pixel phase, one asset per row phase -> ALL PASS. One uncounted infra correction: a shell race re-ran iteration 4 against the pre-edit renderer (identical numbers betrayed it); rerun after verifying the file. Text-placement law derived for this pipeline: pen_y = browserLineFragTop - fragDy(F,L) - c_dev(F,L)/2, with fragDy/c calibrated per (fontSize, lineHeight) pair against Chromium with the same Heebo variable TTF (calibration table in the iteration workspace, reproducible from the probe recipe).
